description: Ding, Yu and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The archive contains the WEICan generator dataset used in the 2025 accumulation-method study. The source establishes a concrete condition-monitoring role in early fault warning for wind turbines. Coverage is the source-defined generator experiment, with sensor channels, turbine count, recording interval and observation dates unspecified in the native description. A separately deposited implementation is linked as the model. The reproducibility report is supporting documentation and was not opened. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The native file inventory establishes deposited data, but values and linked file bodies were not read. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance.
